2026-07-28 06:52:32.414113 | controller |
2026-07-28 06:52:32.414117 | controller | Possible reasons for having these kinds of units are:
2026-07-28 06:52:32.414122 | controller | • A unit may be statically enabled by being symlinked from another unit's
2026-07-28 06:52:32.414252 | controller |   .wants/, .requires/, or .upholds/ directory.
2026-07-28 06:52:32.414259 | controller | • A unit's purpose may be to act as a helper for some other unit which has
2026-07-28 06:52:32.416611 | controller |   a requirement dependency on it.
2026-07-28 06:52:32.416624 | controller | • A unit may be started when needed via activation (socket, path, timer,
